# sophosfirewall_user_group (Resource)

Manages a user group (*Configure > Authentication > Groups*). Built-in groups such as `Open Group` or `Guest Group` can be read with the `sophosfirewall_user_group` data source.

Sign-in IP address restrictions are not managed: the SFOS v23 REST API ignores them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_user_group" "engineering" {
  name                 = "Engineering"
  description          = "Engineering staff"
  surfing_quota_policy = "Unlimited Internet Access"
  access_time_policy   = "Allowed all the time"

  quarantine_digest   = true
  ssl_vpn_policy      = "Remote engineers"
  ipsec_remote_access = true

}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_time_policy` (String) Name of the access time policy, e.g. `Allowed all the time`.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the user group. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `surfing_quota_policy` (String) Name of the surfing quota policy, e.g. `Unlimited Internet Access`.

### Optional

- `clientless_policy` (String) Name of the SSL VPN clientless access policy.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `ipsec_remote_access` (Boolean) Allow IPsec remote access. Defaults to `false`.
- `l2tp` (Boolean) Allow L2TP remote access. Defaults to `false`.
- `mac_binding` (Boolean) Bind members to the MAC address they first sign in from. Defaults to `false`.
- `network_traffic_quota_policy` (String) Name of the network traffic quota policy.
- `pptp` (Boolean) Allow PPTP remote access. Defaults to `false`.
- `quarantine_digest` (Boolean) Send members the email quarantine digest. Defaults to `false`.
- `ssl_vpn_policy` (String) Name of the SSL VPN remote access policy.
- `traffic_shaping_policy` (String) Name of the traffic shaping policy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_user_group.example <name-or-uuid>
```
